## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据**（来源：`financial_statements.txt` 利润表）：
- FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）：**$39,306 百万**
- FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）：**$29,878 百万**

**计算过程**：
$$\frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \approx 31.6\% \rightarrow \textbf{32\%}$$

（恒定汇率口径为 31%，影响约 $80M；来源：`financial_statements.txt`）

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

来源：`transcript.txt`（Amy Hood 发言段，约 24808 字符处）

> "Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency. In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.** Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

关于本地服务器：
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily **driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

---

### 3. 事实 vs 前瞻性表述

| 归因 | 类型 | 区分依据 |
|------|------|----------|
| 收入 $39.3B、同比增长 32% | ✅ 已发生事实 | "Revenue was $39.3 billion and **grew** 32%" — 描述已结束的财季实际业绩 |
| Azure 增长 43% | ✅ 已发生事实 | "revenue **grew** 43%" — 已实现数据 |
| 客户需求持续超过可用产能 | ✅ 已发生事实（当季状态） | "Customer demand **continues to exceed** available capacity" — 描述截至本季度末的持续状态，非未来预测 |
| CPU/GPU 效率提升与新产能更早交付 | ✅ 已发生事实 | "Revenue growth was **ahead of expectations driven by** efficiency gains..." — 解释已发生的超预期原因 |
| 季度内新增 Azure 产能被快速货币化 | ✅ 已发生事实 | "was quickly monetized" — 已完成的商业行为 |
| GitHub Copilot 消费超预期 | ✅ 已发生事实 | "**benefited from** stronger-than-expected... consumption following the **June business model change**" — 6 月已实施的变更及已观察到的结果 |
| 本地服务器同比基本持平（-1%） | ✅ 已发生事实 | "revenue **was** relatively unchanged" — 已实现数据 |
| **Q1 FY27 Intelligent Cloud 收入 $40.95–41.25B，增长 33–34%** | 🔮 前瞻性表述 | "**we expect** revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion" — 明确的未来指引 |
| **Azure Q1 增长约 45%（恒定汇率）** | 🔮 前瞻性表述 | "**we expect** revenue growth of approximately 45%" — 未来指引 |
| **上半年（H1）Azure 增长将加速** | 🔮 前瞻性表述 | "**we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate**" — 未来趋势判断 |
| **本地服务器 Q1 下降低到中个位数** | 🔮 前瞻性表述 | "**we expect** revenue to decline in the low to mid-single digits" — 未来指引 |

**区分方法总结**：
- **已发生事实**：使用过去时态（was, grew, benefited from）或描述截至报告期末的持续状态（continues to exceed），且涉及的是 FY26 Q4 已结束期间的数据或事件（如 6 月商业模式变更）。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用 "we expect"、"we remain focused"、"we continue to expect" 等引导词，明确指向 FY27 Q1 或更长期的未来业绩指引。

**关键判断点**：同一段落中，管理层先陈述已实现的 Q4 业绩（事实），再以"Now, to the outlook for our first quarter"明确切换至未来指引（前瞻）。此外，"customer demand continues to exceed capacity"虽是进行时态，但描述的是 Q4 末的持续状态，归为事实；而"we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"明确是面向未来的预测。
